remarks: This spacious three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath condominium presents a turnkey opportunity in a sought-after location directly opposite Bruce Park. It is ideally located within walking distance to Greenwich Avenue, the train station, The Bruce Museum, and Greenwich Harbor. The expansive open floor plan is enhanced by updated windows throughout and recessed lighting. The stylish kitchen has been fully renovated and features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and ample storage, seamlessly connecting to the dining and family areas. The family room offers a generous layout with a wood-burning fireplace and sliding French doors that open to a generous private patio and garden area, all complemented by a convenient powder room. On the second floor, the primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and an ensuite bath. The sunlit second bedroom provides abundant storage, with a spacious full bath just outside. A vented side-by-side laundry and a wall of closets complete the second floor. The top floor features a flexible third bedroom or office, equipped with skylights and plenty of storage. Two designated outdoor parking spaces are included, allowing for easy access to all the amenities the area has to offer. Low monthly fees cover trash and snow removal, landscaping, and water
